The c1f76ba chunks were whole files of a `--files` hunt pasted into the prompt, refused after one grep: a scope whose every file the commit adds outright (or is a dump) and whose diff the prompt carries now prices nothing (scope.py whole_text, launch.py _record_prompt). Shared cause of both fixes: the floor's base is the diff's bytes, which overprices text the cell holds whole or that is no code. 2026-10-03 regression (3 opus-high legs, rounds 20261002T093329Z/093357Z-4b53f7d): every one refused chunk 21, llm-legs tests/test_worker_run.sh, which the commit DELETES (378 KB diff, the whole removed text, nothing left in the tree to read); whole_text knew added files and dumps but not deletions, so the same overpricing came back. scope.whole_paths now takes --diff-filter=AD. Not fixed, the owner's design call (handoff 2026-09-30 section 2026-10-03): 093329/#6 also refused chunk 6, edited docs whose docs/shared-invariants.md rows run to 17 KB (24 changed lines = 152 KB of diff), after a 12 KB read that did check claims against code; an edited file keeps the floor, so such a docs chunk can still read as R1.

rows.title: Image wrapper argument refusals lack invocation provenance
rows.note: Launch had 84 exits; fresh scan had 85. Live image journal contains mostly usage text (57 codex-image), one Veo duration refusal and one space-joined gemini-listen path. These happen before image_leg_mark; vendor failure is ruled out for these messages. Journal has no argv, cwd or caller, so help probes versus malformed production calls versus tests cannot be confirmed. rows.note: gemini-1790973856-19814-0ac9 and gemini-1790973885-71908-0dd5 (Vector Magic, jihangarangan, logo-vectorizer-bench, 2026-10-02 23:44): meta pid 0, dirty-before-shas.tmp left; memlogd frame 23:45:28 shows both starts alive mid-floor, the relay transcript shows the user interrupting both tool calls at 23:45:41. The tree holds 33.6k untracked paths (1.47 GB). workdir_dirty_paths takes ~15 s per 20k paths because path_shape_ok's `~*` arm is tilde-expanded as user `*` (a getpwnam per call), and a launch lists twice; quoting it cuts that to 0.33 s, but test_consistency pins the arm equal to claude-setup rj_path_shape_ok, so the paired change is handed off. Ruled out: memory guard (no KILLED that day), bash read byte-per-syscall (mapfile measured no faster), reboot. Hashing 1.47 GB stays ~28 s under load 73 even after the fix; moving the floor into the detached supervisor would remove the wait entirely and also register it with the memory guard (start's foreground is unregistered while meta pid is 0). The detail is the narrowest the leg carries: a supervisor that dies mid-run also lands here.
